ELECTRICITY — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning D.C Electric Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits.
   C. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits.

2. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.

3. When learning Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2., the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..

4. When learning Introduction to Electricity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Electricity.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Electricity.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Electricity.

5. When learning Pictorial Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

7. When learning D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.

8. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

9. When learning Cells and Batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.

   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electro- Magnetism.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electro- Magnetism.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electro- Magnetism.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electro- Magnetism.

16. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Equipment at the Consumers Intake Point 3.3 Final Circuits 4.0 Electronics 4.1 S and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Equipment at Consumers Intake Point and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
